# v1.1.2 — catalog resynced to live

A maintenance release. The tool surface, naming and pricing are unchanged; this
only brings the bundled catalog back into agreement with the live Apify Actors.

## What changed

- **`calfire-fhsz-screener` gained an optional `simulateOutage` input.** The
  shipped 1.1.1 catalog predated it, so an agent calling `describe-gov-data-tool`
  on that Actor saw a schema the live Actor no longer matched. Regenerated from
  the live account on 2026-09-19.

## What was verified and did not change

- **120 published Actors, same set** — no additions, no removals, no renames.
- **Zero price changes across all 120.** Pricing moves independently of any
  build, so it is diffed per Actor on every release; the band is $2.50–$100 per
  1,000 (median $8), inside the $0.50–$200 guard that catches the 1000x
  overprice defect.
- No `required[]`, title or description changes on any Actor.
- 15 tools exposed (12 featured + 3 meta), all hyphen-case, all carrying MCP
  annotations. Protocol negotiated: `2025-11-25`, the current revision.

## Gates

`npm test` 63/63 · `node tools/mutate.cjs` 23/23 caught, 0 missed ·
`check:catalog` clean against live · registry constraints (100-char description,
`mcpName` = `server.json` name, version fields tracking `package.json`) all pinned
and passing · `package.json.description` still digit-free.
